title: Forward deployed engineer is now as common as machine learning engineer
description: The forward deployed engineer, who builds AI on site with customers, now appears in as many US AI job ads as the machine learning engineer.
dek: A job title popularized by Palantir now shows up in as many US AI job ads as machine learning engineer: 304 ads against 306.
findings: Forward deployed engineers build software alongside a customer, on the customer's own data. In 2,046 recent US AI job ads, 304 carry that title, from 213 employers.
That is level with machine learning engineer, at 306 ads from 210 employers. Only data scientist (479) and AI engineer (435) are more common.
The title follows Palantir's model of sending engineers to the customer. Palantir's AIP Bootcamp promises 'from 0 to use case in 5 days' on the customer's own data.
Consulting firms hire for it too: Deloitte, for example, advertises a Senior Anthropic forward deployed engineer role.

chart.title: US AI job ads by job title
chart.subtitle: Ads posted between 21 and 25 Nov 2026; 2,046 ads after reposts removed

method: I pulled the 3,000 newest US job ads with AI or machine-learning job titles posted between 21 and 25 Nov 2026, from the jobspipe job index, and removed reposts (same title, same company).
Each ad goes to the first title group its job title matches, in a fixed order, so no ad is counted twice.
Titles that match none of the groups are left out of the chart.
The job index keeps about four months of ads, so this is a snapshot, not a trend; I will repeat it monthly.
